note: The docs of each component for the docs panel of an example page. examples/docs.js shows them. The keys, the types and the states come from the catalog contract, not from this file. Each sample is a valid fill, and tests/test_example_docs.py validates it. repository is the address that shows each doc path as a page. Synthetic data only.

events: An action of a part goes up to the page if the thread has no perform function. detail is the request.
thread.actions: Page code sets thread.bind, a function that gives the binding of each action part, and thread.perform, a function that sends the request and gives the receipt.

events: The element refused a fill. detail.errors gives each error with its path.
application.actions: An application component sends the events that its element class defines.

events: A person changed the value. The value in detail is true or false. A typed field also sends an event for the edit type.
The element refused a fill. The detail gives the errors and their paths.
toggle-field.actions: The field sends no action. An editable form sends its boolean value.
howto: Bind an action
Put the field in an editable form. Add its name and label to the editable object of the action.
Read a receipt
Give the receipt to the form. The form shows the result.
Show an error
Set error on the field to show a message. The message describes the input.

field.actions: A field sends no action. A form sends the values of its fields as one action.
howto: Bind an action
Put the field in an editable form or a form card. Set form.action = { tool, title, label, editable } in page code. editable gives each name that the form can send.
Read a receipt
Listen for mu-action on the form, send event.detail to your API, then call form.receipt({ id, ok, message }). The form shows Done only after this call.
Show an error
Call form.receipt with ok set to false and a short message. The form shows Not done and the message. A value that the field does not accept shows its reason below the field and sends no action.

action-button.actions: Page code binds the tool with the action property, for example { tool: 'library.renew', label: 'Renew' }. A fill cannot name a tool. The button shows Pending after a press, and Done only after receipt().

data.label: Renew
data.description: Renew the loan for two weeks.

howto: Bind an action
Set button.action = { tool: 'library.renew', label: 'Renew', arguments: { loan_id: 'L-0001' } } in page code. The label must be equal to the label of the fill.
Read a receipt
Listen for mu-action, send event.detail to your API, then call button.receipt({ id, ok, message, reference }).
Show an error
Call button.receipt with ok set to false and a short message. The button shows Not done and the message.

table.actions: The table sends no action. A sort changes only the order on the screen.
howto: Bind an action
A table has no action. Put an action button for a row next to the table, and bind it in page code, as the review queue example does.
Read a receipt
Give the receipt to that button with button.receipt({ id, ok, message }). Then set a new fill on the table with the new row status text.
Show an error
Give the row a status text, for example Not done. For a fill that is not valid, the table shows a refusal and sends mu-refused.

events: A person saved a cell. detail is the request: the id, the tool, and the arguments with the row key, the column key and the value.
The element refused a fill. detail.errors gives each error with its path.
data-grid.actions: Page code binds the tool with the action property: { tool, arguments, title, rows, columns }. Each saved cell is one action.
howto: Bind an action
Set grid.action = { tool, title, rows, columns } in page code. rows and columns give the key, the label and the type of each row and column that a person can edit.
Read a receipt
Listen for mu-action, send event.detail to your API, then call grid.receipt({ id, ok, message }). The cell shows Pending until this call.
Show an error

Call grid.receipt with ok set to false and a short message. The cell shows Not done, and the status text below the grid gives the message. A value of the wrong type shows its reason and sends no action.
